_meta.description: Map-valued crosstab cells: region (rows) × 10-year age band (columns) with AGG_SET_FREQUENCY as the cell aggregator, so each cell carries a {label: count} map of the card issuers selected in that region and age band; margins are maps too. normalize must stay none: a map-valued cell under any other normalize is refused with PULSE_CROSSTAB_NORMALIZE_MAP_VALUED.
_meta.name: crosstab_set_frequency_map_cells
